title: Apple (AAPL) Launches Apple Upgrade With Klarna To Recast Device Payments
desc:
Apple is launching a new device leasing program called Apple Upgrade in the U.S., partnering with Klarna.
The program will cover iPhone, Mac, iPad, and Apple Watch through lease-to-own payment options.
Apple plans to phase out new enrollments in its existing iPhone payment plans as Apple Upgrade rolls out.

title: Vicious 5-dog attack leaves Nnete, 12, without ears, lip - but donors rally to help
desc: Twelve-year-old Nnete Leotlela is known by his family as a humble, compassionate, brave and smart Mosotho boy who loves and adores everyone he meets.
